examples.text: It follows from what has been said that a vague thought has more likelihood of being true than a precise one. To try and hit an object with a precise thought is like trying to hit the bull's eye with a bullet. The advantage of the precise thought is that it distinguishes between the bull's eye and the rest of the target.
